title: Health check is static and does not verify DB connectivity
evidence: app.py:75-76 — GET /health returns a hard-coded {"status": "ok"} without touching SQLite

title: PUT uses full-replace semantics (title+author always required)
evidence: app.py:106-115 — PUT calls _validated_book(), so a partial update without title/author returns 400 rather than merging fields
suggestion: Acceptable per spec ('update a book'); if partial updates are desired, add PATCH or merge with the existing row
